name: Le Plume
summary: An approachable, cape-focused Kaizo ROM hack of Super Mario World. Designed around accessible flight mechanics, the hack features short, bite-sized sections and patched cape turnarounds to create a smoother learning curve for players. Spanning 12 exits in total, players navigate 11 main stages while hunting for unique custom moons hidden in each level; collecting all of them unlocks the 12th and final stage.
